_summary: Read in full on 2026-10-07: the candidate of #22 (answer and formula first, figures from the question, each thing said once), all 30 cases, 40 s apart. 26 of 30 automatically; all four automated failures are the checker's (b-leverage's 'the same at 10x and at 2x'; p-size's ceil(2,000/480) − 1 = 4; o-montecarlo's 'can't be run here — not something troid computes'; d-stock's missing word 'rules' where it says 'nothing to size'). On a read, one error, minor: s-product's lead-in twice (repeated text; the lint's 25-word bound let it through). No critical, no major. #22's fixes held: b-leverage opens 'No —' with its formula before the example; o-montecarlo works 0.21R from the question and asks for nothing; s-firm and p-crossover say each thing once. Run 28's held: ex-angry has no first person; p-crossover's below-$98,000 budget is under $4,000. $1.0384 on the eval key.
